title: The Good Samaritan
summaryZh: 永生是從認識基督開始，而我們對周遭受苦的鄰舍負有愛的責任。
lines: Everybody would like to know that when you die, you're going to heaven.
每個人都想知道，當死後你會上天堂。
You know you're going to die.
你知道你將會面臨死亡。
It is appointed unto man once to die.
按著定命，人人都有一死。
But you'd like to know that you have eternal life.
但你想要知道你擁有永生。
Now, eternal life does not begin at death.
然而，永生並不是在死後才開始。
Eternal life begins the moment you know Christ as your Lord and Savior.
永生是從你認識基督為你主和救主的那一刻就開始了。
There are many people that are here and now, alive physically, but you're dead spiritually.
有許多人此時此地在肉體上是活著的，但在屬靈上你卻是死的。
You have no relationship and no fellowship with God whatsoever.
你與神之間沒有任何關係，也沒有絲毫團契。
You go to church, and you go through all the rituals,
你去教會，經歷所有的儀式，
and you have religion, but you don't really have Jesus Christ.
你擁有了宗教，但你並沒有真正擁有耶穌基督。
And so, religion becomes rather dull to you.
因此，宗教對你來說變得相當枯燥。
So you try to find your kicks in drugs, or sex, or something else.
所以你試圖在毒品、性或其他事物中尋找刺激。
You turn to other things to escape,
你轉向其他事物來逃避，
because there's always this empty place in everybody's heart,
因為在每個人的心中，總有這樣一個空處，
that only God can fill, because you were made in the image of God,
只有神能填滿，因為你是照著神的形像造的，
and without God, there's an emptiness, there's a lacking.
若沒有神，就會有一種空虛，一種缺失。
Yet you're always, all your life, searching for something,
然而你終其一生，總是在尋找某種東西，
and you're searching for eternal life.
You can have eternal life right tonight.
你就在今晚就可以擁有永生。
It could start tonight in your heart, as Christ comes to dwell in your life and in your heart.
當基督進入你的生命和你的心中居住時，它今晚就可以在你心裡開始。
It was a social question: "Who is my neighbor?"
這是一個社會性的問題：「誰是我的鄰舍呢？」
"Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart,
with all thy soul, with all thy strength,
850 million people on this planet live on a starvation diet at this moment.
這一刻，地球上有八億五千萬人正處於極度飢餓狀態。
飢餓飲食 (極度缺乏食物)
When is the last time you shared your social life with someone of another race or another ethnic background,
你上一次與不同種族或不同文化背景的人分享你的社交生活，
or your material goods with the poor,
或是將你的物質財富分享給窮人，
or your knowledge with those who need an education,
或是將你的知識分享給那些需要教育的人，
or your skills with the untrained,
或是將你的技能分享給未受過訓練的人，
and your compassion and prayers for the peace of the world?
以及為世界和平獻上你的憐憫和代禱，是在什麼時候呢？
Have you cared for the aged, the handicapped, the blind, the alcoholic, the dope addict,
你是否關心過年長者、殘疾人士、盲人、酗酒者和染上毒癮的人，
the morally fallen, with your love and concern?
並且用你的愛與關懷去照顧那些道德墮落的人？
What is your responsibility to your neighbor?
你對你的鄰舍有什麼責任？
In the modern world of transportation and technology,
在這個交通和科技發達的現代世界中，
the whole world has become a neighborhood, without being a brotherhood.
整個世界已經變成了一個社區，卻沒有成為一個弟兄和睦同居的群體。
The whole world suddenly becomes our neighbor.
整個世界突然都成了我們的鄰舍。
Those people that are suffering in Southeast Asia are our neighbors.
那些在東南亞受苦的人是我們的鄰舍。
Those people suffering in Central Africa are our neighbors,
那些在中非受苦的人也是我們的鄰舍，
and we have a responsibility to them.
而我們對他們負有責任。
The Scripture says Jesus came to heal the broken-hearted.
聖經上說，耶穌來是要醫治傷心的人。
A new book has just come out by a psychiatrist entitled, The Broken Heart.
最近一位精神科醫生剛出版了一本新書，書名叫做《破碎的心》。
And in Toronto, delegates came from all around the world to a convention on mended hearts.
在多倫多，來自世界各地的代表參加了一個關於修復心靈的大會。
Jesus came to heal broken hearts.
耶穌來，就是要醫治破碎的心。
How many broken hearts are here tonight?
今晚這裡有多少顆破碎的心？
